Change domain includes dimension/spec without supporting changed-spec evidence.

Treat 1st, 2nd, and total rows as subgroup or rollup context, not changed factors.
Rebuild tension outcome from rows 25 and 26 with min, max, average kgf values.
Add dyne-pen and VP+CD separate OK/NG outcomes from rows 16-21.
Validate function rows 29-40 and cite all row texts used, including totals.
